# `rx`

Helper: `rx({ title, count, empty, sections: [{ title, sub, lines | groups: [{ heading, lines }] }] })`  
Kit (`src/ui`): web-only (kit gap) · status: kit gap (web-only)  
App (KMP `core:ui`): `PemaCareRow` (core:ui), `PemaNotice` (core:ui)

## Anatomy

Card "Đơn & phiếu đã duyệt" with a count chip and one section per approved prescription or order (groups "Đơn thuốc" / "Phiếu tư vấn").

## Variants

- With sections
- Pending / empty: chip "Chưa có" and the sentence "Đơn và phiếu sẽ xuất hiện sau khi bác sĩ duyệt."

## States

- Static: it has no hover, focus or disabled state of its own

## Tokens

heading, ink, ink-soft, line, text-body-lg, text-label

## Do

- List only approved items

## Don't

- Never list a prescription that the doctor has not approved

## Web (1440 and 1920)

Sections divided by a line.

## Mobile (390)

Same as 1440; the frame is narrower, nothing is hidden.

## Rules (design-specs/web/BLOCKS.md)

The card "Đơn & phiếu đã duyệt" with the chip "<n> đơn" and one section per approved prescription or cashier order (groups "Đơn thuốc" / "Phiếu tư vấn"). No `sections` = pending/empty state: chip "Chưa có" and "Đơn và phiếu sẽ xuất hiện sau khi bác sĩ duyệt." A pending (unapproved) prescription is never listed
